result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The full codeanalyzer suite passes (335 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped), and a new test covering the fixes passes too. Nothing is committed.

- **Generated HTML (3 rules):** the path pattern `.*[.](html|html|xhtml)` is now `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`, so pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator pages match `.htm`, and `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **.NET XML docs:** `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` line check is unchanged.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by`:** `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the four cases match, that `build.gradle` still matches, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.html`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated and build scopes.
